analysis.subject: finance
analysis.pageCoverage: Page explains how credit card interest is calculated daily from average daily balance, how different APR categories are disclosed, how grace periods apply to purchases, and how payments over the minimum are allocated.

overview.headline: How daily interest accrues and payments apply to card balances

keyPoints.point: Students learn that issuers calculate interest daily using the average daily balance.
keyPoints.quote: Many credit card companies calculate the interest you owe daily, based on your average daily account balance.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that the interest charged each day is called the daily periodic rate.
keyPoints.quote: The interest charged daily is called the daily periodic rate.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that a grace period lets cardholders avoid interest on purchases by paying the full balance by the due date.
keyPoints.quote: If your card has a grace period, you can avoid paying interest on purchases if you pay off your balance in full by the due date each month.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that payments above the minimum go first to the balance with the highest interest rate and then to other balances in descending order.
keyPoints.quote: the card issuer must generally apply the amount you pay over the minimum first to the balance with the highest interest rate

keyTerms.gloss: average of daily balances used to calculate interest owed
keyTerms.quote: Many credit card companies calculate the interest you owe daily, based on your average daily account balance.

keyTerms.gloss: interest charged each day based on the periodic rate
keyTerms.quote: The interest charged daily is called the daily periodic rate.

keyTerms.gloss: time to pay balance in full and avoid interest on purchases
keyTerms.quote: If your card has a grace period, you can avoid paying interest on purchases if you pay off your balance in full by the due date each month.

keyTerms.gloss: rate shown on statement for each balance category
keyTerms.quote: Your statement must show each category with a different APR and the amount of the balance that falls in each category.

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Builds recall of daily rate definition, grace period conditions, and payment allocation rule from the text.
componentPlan.focusQuote: The interest charged daily is called the daily periodic rate.

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Helps learners contrast purchase versus cash categories on rate differences and grace period eligibility.
componentPlan.focusQuote: Often card companies charge one interest rate for purchases and different interest rates if you use your credit card to get cash
